title: Fullstack Next.js + Prisma AGENTS.md Generation
prompt: Generate a production-ready AGENTS.md for a Next.js 15, React 19, and Prisma web application managed with pnpm. Include explicit single-test execution commands, Client Component conventions, and Never Do boundaries.

expected_elements.header_and_overview: # AGENTS.md followed by tech stack identification (Next.js, TypeScript, React, pnpm).
expected_elements.architectural_conventions: Rules covering Client Component minimalism, Tailwind utility usage, and Zod validation.
boundaries_and_never: Never modify .next/ or dist/ build output folders.
Never commit .env or .env.local files containing secrets.
Never edit Prisma migration SQL files directly.

title: Python FastAPI + SQLAlchemy Backend Service AGENTS.md
prompt: Generate an AGENTS.md for a Python 3.12 FastAPI microservice managed with uv and Alembic. Include single-test pytest patterns, Pydantic validation rules, and database migration guardrails.

expected_elements.stack_and_manifests: Python 3.12, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, uv sync.
expected_elements.conventions: Layer separation (Routers -> Service -> Repository), async sessions, Pydantic validation.
expected_elements.boundaries: Never edit committed migration files in alembic/versions/ directly; never commit secrets.

title: Monorepo Workspace Root & Nested Package Scaffolding
prompt: Scaffold a root AGENTS.md and a nested AGENTS.md for `apps/web` in a Turborepo monorepo managed via pnpm workspaces. Enforce package filter commands and localized subpackage scoping.

expected_elements.root_boundaries: Never run global build/test when working on an isolated package.
expected_elements.nested_header: # AGENTS.md - apps/web with inheritance note pointing to root AGENTS.md

title: Consolidate .cursorrules and CLAUDE.md into AGENTS.md with Bridges
prompt: Inspect existing .cursorrules and CLAUDE.md files in the repository, consolidate operational rules into AGENTS.md, and create lightweight bridges so Claude Code and Cursor continue functioning without drift.

expected_elements.rule_consolidation: Unified AGENTS.md containing deduplicated commands, conventions, and boundaries.
expected_elements.zero_drift: Single source of truth architecture maintained.

title: Audit and Remediate a Flawed Legacy AGENTS.md
prompt: Audit an AGENTS.md file that contains unreplaced [TODO] strings, lacks a single-test command, lacks 'Never Do' boundaries, and exceeds 250 lines of narrative text. Output the quality score (<60) and remediation checklist.

expected_elements.placeholder_penalty: Flags unreplaced [TODO] tokens with zero score for rubric criterion 10.
expected_elements.single_test_failure: Flags missing targeted single-test command with FAIL status.
expected_elements.bloat_penalty: Flags excessive line count (>220 lines) with FAIL on token budget.
expected_elements.remediation_actions: Provides specific numbered remediation action items to achieve >=80/100 score.
